chains.title: Advisors are aging people whose availability differs from their skill
verified: Featured people have initial age/range, chosen skills, trait exclusions and council positions.
Managed Person routes age, family, health, availability and skills separately to native engine; dead and away states change display.
Native ageRing loops seven ring slots and calls annual person aging; agePerson writes age and yearsOnRing.
manual_semantics: Reorganizing trades skill mix against religion mix; hereditary king need not be chief.
chains.inference: Treat replacement as a social/history choice, not swapping a stat bundle.
chains.limits: Exact mortality odds, skill-aging formula and inheritance graphs not reconstructed.

chains.title: An annual forecast precedes a real preparation budget and retained reserve
verified: SacredTime.OnShow reads forecast and magic reserve, sets ten allocation capacities from Game.MaxMagic.
OnToggle bounds remaining capacity; Proceed writes each allocation, subtracts total magicUsed and advances native SacredTime.
manual_semantics: Ring religion changes allocation maximum; annual allocations affect related actions throughout year; reserve helps later situations.
chains.inference: Present upcoming risk before a player chooses one annual preparation and reserves resources.
chains.limits: Annual action modifier consumers remain native/unread; no assumed exact multipliers.

chains.title: Ventures connect qualified people, calendar capacity and repairable aftermath
verified: VentureDialogController uses native eligibility to enable buttons, reports why-not, derives skill and best/performing person, and StartVenture passes ID and leader then advances turn when appropriate.
Lua entries gate repair/reputation/pasture recovery by circumstances and assign distinct skills/religion modifiers.
manual_semantics: Two ventures per year initially, tasks occupy coordinated effort and usually run through year.
Damaged houses need goods; fort damage enables repair; some destruction is irreparable.
chains.inference: A setback should unlock a concrete repair task with its own skill/resource cost.
chains.limits: Lua whyNot strings describe constraints; native validation/cost/outcome code not reconstructed for each venture.

chains.title: Neglect becomes specific relationship or world consequences at coarse boundaries
verified: Lua config supplies absence thresholds: spirit bargains7 years, caravans4, emissaries4, exploration3, raids5, rituals10.
Native handleMoot reads lastCaravan and threshold then constructs/adds a concern; reads lastEmissary/threshold and writes other clans likesUs; raid absence reduces fearsUs.
Native handleSacredTime reads bargain/exploration/ritual timestamps and thresholds, adds concerns or threat variables.
chains.inference: Store last meaningful contact timestamp and resolve missed years into one bounded fact, not hourly NPC ticks.
chains.limits: Exact numeric penalties, all qualifying activity reset sites and concern decay remain unread.

chains.title: Temporary scene context is cleared after outcomes, while history is committed
verified: OSL.lua lists transient advisor/family/test/choice variables reset before or after interactivity.
Native Script.checkResult dispatches result and calls resetVariablesAfterInteractivity. Script.completed calls saga.finishEntry and reset.
chains.inference: Keep event-local context separate from persistent biography; commit one outcome then erase scratch to prevent later advice contamination.
chains.limits: Individual scene programs, choice costs and odds are retained bytecode but unread.

chains.title: History is readable by year and ruler; rewind is a separate explicit operation
verified: Game wrappers expose SagaForYear, NameOfRulerInYear, SaveAsYearlySave and LoadGameYear.
SagaView loads selected year, hides restore for current year, gates by canBeRestored and requests confirmation before RestoreToYear.
manual_semantics: Saga records clan events/starting lore, begins year with omen and groups years under king; restoring discards subsequent progress.
chains.inference: A readable yearly history index can be independent of detailed tick logs and recovery checkpoints.
chains.limits: Native encoding, compression, retention and actual snapshot file format unrecovered; no save-size claim.

native_boundary.meaning: DllImport bridge confirms native simulation ownership; managed wrapper export is not reconstruction of all native mechanics.
